digest.lead: Claude Code shipped two updates today, with v2.1.107 improving thinking hints and v2.1.105 adding significant developer workflow features like worktree switching and plugin monitoring.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, a new security benchmark tests whether LLMs can find real vulnerabilities in codebases, and Anthropic faced a legal setback over supply chain risk labeling.

stories.headline: Claude.ai Service Disruption Draws Community Attention
stories.summary: Claude.ai experienced a service outage that generated significant discussion on Hacker News [1]. The incident was tracked on Anthropic's status page and drew 123 comments from users.
stories.impact: Affects all Claude.ai users and highlights the platform's growing importance as service disruptions now generate substantial community discussion.

stories.headline: Anthropic Loses Legal Challenge Over Supply Chain Risk Designation
stories.summary: A federal appeals court rejected Anthropic's bid to pause a supply chain risk label [1]. The decision represents a setback for the company's legal strategy regarding regulatory compliance.
stories.impact: Could affect Anthropic's business operations and regulatory standing, particularly for enterprise customers evaluating Claude for sensitive applications.

sources.title: Anthropic loses appeals court bid to pause supply chain risk label

stories.headline: Claude Code Ships Two Updates with Developer Workflow Improvements
stories.summary: Claude Code released v2.1.107 with faster thinking hints during long operations [1], followed by the more substantial v2.1.105 update [2]. The larger release adds worktree switching via a new `path` parameter, plugin monitoring capabilities, and improved API stream handling with 5-minute timeouts.
key_points: v2.1.105 introduces worktree switching and plugin background monitoring
PreCompact hooks can now block compaction operations
Improved handling of stalled API streams with automatic 5-minute timeouts
stories.impact: Benefits developers using Claude Code for complex repository management and long-running operations, with better plugin support for workflow automation.

stories.headline: New Security Benchmark Tests LLMs on Real Vulnerability Detection
stories.summary: N-Day-Bench launched as a benchmark to evaluate whether large language models can identify genuine security vulnerabilities in real codebases [1]. The project has gained attention on Hacker News with 59 points and active discussion.
stories.impact: Relevant for developers and security teams evaluating Claude's capabilities for code security analysis and vulnerability detection workflows.

sources.title: N-Day-Bench – Can LLMs find real vulnerabilities in real codebases?

stories.headline: Use the path parameter with EnterWorktree to switch between git worktrees
stories.summary: The EnterWorktree tool now accepts a path parameter that lets you switch into existing worktrees of your current repository. This makes it easier to work with multiple branches or feature development in parallel without switching repositories.
actionable_steps: Identify the worktree path you want to switch to in your current repository
Use the EnterWorktree tool with the path parameter: `EnterWorktree(path="/path/to/your/worktree")`
Verify you're in the correct worktree by checking the current branch or directory

stories.headline: Write a CLAUDE.md file to set project conventions once
stories.summary: Adding a CLAUDE.md to your project root lets you define coding standards, test commands, and architectural decisions that persist across every Claude Code session. Think of it as onboarding documentation that Claude reads automatically — you teach it once instead of repeating yourself.
actionable_steps: Create a CLAUDE.md in your project root with build/test/lint commands
Add coding conventions like naming patterns, preferred libraries, and file structure
Include architectural decisions and constraints Claude should respect
Use /init in Claude Code to auto-generate a starter CLAUDE.md

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature

stories.headline: Add session tracking header for proxy aggregation
stories.summary: Use the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header in your API requests to help proxies group requests by session without needing to parse request bodies. This improves routing and monitoring capabilities when using Claude Code through proxy servers.
actionable_steps: Add the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header to your Claude Code API requests
Set the header value to your session identifier
Configure your proxy to use this header for request aggregation instead of body parsing

stories.headline: Use _meta annotation to prevent large MCP tool results from being truncated
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports preserving large tool results (like database schemas) up to 500K characters by adding a special metadata annotation. This prevents important data from being cut off during processing.
actionable_steps: Add `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation to your MCP tool result
Set the value to your desired character limit (up to 500,000)
Test with large results like database schemas to verify they pass through completely
